evals.prompt: Add an invoice export so finance can download all invoices for a month.
evals.expected_output: Full flow start: a brief with goal, out of scope, numbered testable acceptance criteria and open questions; task classified; applicable and N/A rules listed; no code written yet.
assertions: Writes a brief into docs/PROCESS.md with numbered acceptance criteria
Does not write or edit any source code before the brief is confirmed
Classifies the task (lane and areas touched)
Lists applicable standards and any N/A rule with a one-line reason
Asks only questions it could not answer from the repo, with a recommended answer

evals.expected_output: Asks for steps to reproduce and expected versus actual behaviour instead of guessing the requirement.
assertions: Does not invent a requirement from the title alone
Asks for reproduction steps and expected behaviour
Puts unanswered points in open questions

evals.prompt: I think I'm done with the invoice export. All tests pass but I didn't save any screenshots or query plans. Can I open the PR?
evals.expected_output: Done check lists items with proof, gathers what it can itself, and names exactly which items are still open.
assertions: Does not tick an item that has no proof
Runs the available checks itself (for example the tests) and reports what it found
Lists each missing item and what would close it
Marks N/A only with a written reason the developer confirms

evals.prompt: Set up the dev process for this project, then fix the typo in the page heading (it says Custmers). It is an existing small app.
evals.expected_output: Prepares the project with minimal questions or stated defaults, does not scan the whole project, then continues with the heading fix.
assertions: Asks the setup questions in one message, or states the defaults it chose
CLAUDE.md, docs/PROCESS.md and .devprocess/config.json exist after setup, and no existing file was overwritten
Does not map or scan the whole project and does not create docs/BASELINE.md or docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
Continues with the heading fix after setup
Does not ask the developer to choose a lane

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
evals.expected_output: Not about the process; the skill should not run.
assertions: Does not load dev-process or create any process files

evals.prompt: Production is slow and users say the orders page times out. Sort it out.
evals.expected_output: Routes a production issue to the hotfix or fix lane, not the full feature flow.
assertions: Routes to the hotfix or fix lane, not the full feature flow
Does not write a long brief with acceptance criteria
Does not touch production

evals.prompt: Analyze this project against our frontend and backend standards.
evals.expected_output: A short table with Present, Partial, Missing or N/A per standard, each marked as current task, project gap or unrelated; no code changed.
assertions: Uses the marks Present, Partial, Missing or N/A for each standard
Marks each row as current task, project gap or unrelated
Does not edit any source code
Says the result is sample-based or limited
Saves the report as a new timestamped file in docs/analysis/ with a header line (date, commit, mode, standard), or presents a compact table
Runs light mode: does not map the whole project or create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

evals.prompt: Show me the approved patterns for modal.
evals.expected_output: Lists matching Approved or Active patterns from docs/PATTERNS.md, or says there are none; does not search the codebase or invent patterns.
assertions: Reads docs/PATTERNS.md or says it does not exist or is empty
Does not invent a pattern
Does not list Candidate or Deprecated patterns by default

evals.prompt: Add a refund button on the order page that calls the payment provider and refunds the full amount.
evals.expected_output: In a Safe project, treats this task as Risk because it touches money: applies the untagged rules to the changed code, keeps the project standard Safe, and does not ask the developer to choose a standard.
assertions: Says this task is treated as Risk (or applies the full rule set) because it touches payments or money
Does not change the project standard in docs/PROCESS.md from Safe
Does not ask the developer to choose a standard, tier or lane
Plans or mentions an audit or log entry for the refund

evals.prompt: Add a delete button for customers on the customers page.
evals.expected_output: Adds a log or audit line for the delete in the changed code path (logging check).
assertions: The delete code path it adds or changes has a log or audit call
Does not add logging to unrelated existing code
